chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, raising it, said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'When things get paired, the pairing of the laziness and the frustration, so the result which is manifested by these two, is the poverty'.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between laziness, inability, and poverty according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the metaphysical pairing of laziness (*al-kasal*) and incapacity (*al-'ajz*), identifying their combined progeny as poverty (*al-faqar*). This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that spiritual and physical lethargy are not merely personal flaws but causal agents that generate material destitution, linking inner state to outer circumstance. The narration underscores the importance of active effort (*ijtihad* in worldly affairs) as a spiritual duty to avoid the 'birth' of poverty.
